original.target_description: Table 5, Eq. 6, main model: first difference in working-age population share (15–64/total population), predicting the first difference of logged real per-capita household consumption; GMM dynamic panel of 12 European countries.

n.sample_role: Country panels, not country-year observations. The paper identifies N = 12 countries used in the dynamic panel; exact usable country-year count for this equation is not printed.
n.exclusions: Belgium removed because only four data were available. Raw balanced panel spans 1970–1996 (T = 27); lag/instrument losses are not enumerated.
n.location: Published article p. 1396 (PDF p. 30), Data Appendix, Data used for regressions; p. 1384 (PDF p. 18), Section 4
n.quote:
To obtain a balanced panel, we removed from our sam-
ple Belgium for which only four data were available, yielding a 12 country sample
ranging from 1970 to 1996 (T = 27).

es.location: Published article p. 1385 (PDF p. 19), Table 5, main model, Eq. 6, Udit row

p.location: Published article p. 1385 (PDF p. 19), Table 5, main model, Eq. 6, Udit row; significance legend p. 1387 (PDF p. 21)

notes: Fresh blind original-only extraction from the supplied published article. The unassigned replication and success fields are placeholders. The named coefficient is printed, but its coefficient-specific t/z statistic and exact p are not printed. Parentheses contain Newey–West standard errors, not test statistics. No coefficient/SE conversion was performed. The p value is a two-tailed significance threshold from the printed stars, recorded conservatively as <=, not an exact p. The 12 is the analytic number of country panels; it must not be interpreted as the regression observation count.
